findings.label: Focus state leakage across tasks
findings.description: The focusState object tracks which task initiated focus using taskId, but only prevents display leakage in the top task section. If focus is started on a queue task and then the page re-renders, stale state could persist. Current implementation minimizes this risk by checking focusState.taskId === topTask.id, but a cleaner approach would isolate focus state per task or reset it on component remount.

findings.label: Deadline badge class inconsistency
findings.description: TaskCard uses deadlineBadgeClass() which includes color-coded backgrounds and borders based on deadline urgency, but the top task section manually constructs deadline pills with static styling (bg-slate-700/50 text-slate-300). For visual consistency, both sections should use the same utility function. The top task deadline should use deadlineBadgeClass() to reflect urgency the same way the queue does.

findings.label: Minor variable naming confusion
findings.description: availableTimeMs is named to suggest milliseconds but stores minutes (sum of estimated_minutes). When passed to formatMinutes(), it works correctly because formatMinutes expects minutes. Rename to availableTimeMinutes for clarity, or update the calculation to actually convert to milliseconds if that's the intent.
